verdict.rationale: Merchants explicitly opt in per agent: they find the agent, review its terms, and send an approval request. OCAs can only be initiated by the seller, authorize data access between agent and seller, and can be terminated by either party at any time, which amounts to per-agent allow and deny/revoke for catalog and checkout access. There is no evidence of merchant-side rate-limiting or throttling of agent traffic, and ACS is in private preview. Missing for 10: merchant-configurable rate limits per agent or platform, granular per-agent controls beyond the connect/terminate agreement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
